text:
Starting the repo search now, limited to the README, docs, and the accounts/auth/permissions/billing code.


<invoke name="Glob">
<parameter name="pattern">README*</parameter>
</invoke>
<invoke name="Glob">
<parameter name="pattern">docs/**</parameter>
</invoke>
<invoke name="Glob">
<parameter name="pattern">**/*{account,auth,user,permission,role,billing,subscription,plan,invoice}*</parameter>
</invoke>



<invoke name="Bash">
<parameter name="command">cd /private/tmp/pgbench/cwd-guided && ls -la && find . -maxdepth 3 -not -path './node_modules*' -not -path './.git/*' | head -100</parameter>
</invoke>



<invoke name="Grep">
<parameter name="pattern">(?i)(account|auth|permission|role|billing|subscription|owner)</parameter>
<parameter name="path">/private/tmp/pgbench/cwd-guided</parameter>
<parameter name="output_mode">files_with_matches</parameter>
<parameter name="head_limit">50</parameter>
</invoke>



<invoke name="Bash">
<parameter name="command">cd /private/tmp/pgbench/cwd-guided && ls -la</parameter>
</invoke>



<invoke name="Glob">
<parameter name="pattern">**/*</parameter>
<parameter name="path">/private/tmp/pgbench/cwd-guided</parameter>
</invoke>



<invoke name="Bash">
<parameter name="command">cd /private/tmp/pgbench/cwd-guided && find . -type f | head -200; echo "---count:"; find . -type f | wc -l</parameter>
</invoke>
